testCase.name: XML Layout Inflation
testCase.description: Runtime inflation error due to unknown attribute

error.message: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView

expectedFix.explanation: Remove invalid attribute or use android:textStyle="bold"

agent_response.error: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView
agent_response.rootCause: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView at app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml:12
fixGuidelines: 1. Remove the invalid attribute android:textFontWeight from the TextView in activity_main.xml.
2. Replace it with a valid attribute such as android:textStyle or use a custom font family with variable weights.
3. Ensure that any custom fonts are properly defined and supported by the Android version being used.
4. Verify that all XML attributes used are part of the supported set for TextView in Android versions compatible with the current build setup.
